That's a fantastic question! Proper care and maintenance are key to ensuring your Namesake furniture looks its best and lasts for years to come. We've put together some guidelines to help you keep your pieces in beautiful condition.

Here’s how you can care for your furniture:

Upholstered Furniture
For most needs, a cotton cloth and a non-toxic cleanser will do the trick.
Our fabric is designed to be stain and water resistant, so small spills will bead on the surface. This makes them easy to clean if wiped up immediately.
If you have a spill, blot it immediately with water. This will remove most spills. Remember to dab with a clean cloth, not rub, as rubbing or soaking water into the fabric can cause stains.
If you plan to use a fabric cleanser, always test it first on an inconspicuous spot to ensure it doesn't discolor the fabric.
Wood Furniture
If the paint on your furniture happens to chip, we offer Greenguard approved touch-up pens to correct cosmetic imperfections.
If you'd like to order a touch-up pen, you can fill out our replacement parts form. We'll then provide you with a quotation and invoice to complete your order.

You can find more detailed information on caring for your furniture in our support article here: How should my furniture be cared for and cleaned?
